});\n  return { context, page, errors, name };\n}\nconst shot = (page, n) => page.screenshot({ path: `${outDir}/${n}.png`, animations: 'disabled', timeout: 10000 });\nasync function readState(page) {\n  return page.evaluate(() => ({\n    dir: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).direction,\n    lang: document.documentElement.lang || null,\n    docW: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, viewW: window.innerWidth,\n    nav: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('nav button')).map((e) => e.innerText.trim().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 40)),\n    buttons: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0)\n      .map((e) => (e.innerText || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 80)),\n    headings: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4')).map((e) => e.innerText.trim().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 90)).slice(0, 12),\n    body: (document.body.innerText || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 3000),\n  }));\n}\nasync function clickText(page, re, { nth = 0 } = {}) {\n  const bs = await page.locator('button').all(); const m = [];\n  for (const b of bs) { const t = (await b.innerText()).trim(); if (re.test(t) && (await b.isEnabled())) m.push({ b, t }); }\n  if (!m[nth]) return null; await m[nth].b.click(); return m[nth].t;\n}\nasync function onboard(page, { lang = /Français/, name = 'Learner QA' } = {}) {\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').first().fill(name);\n  await page.getByRole('button', { name: lang }).first().click();\n  await delay(200);\n  if (!(await clickText(page, /Meet Your AI Companion|Continuer|متابعة للتعارف/))) throw new Error('step1 failed');\n  await delay(350);\n  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {\n    const bs = await page.locator('button').all();\n    for (const b of bs) { const t = (await b.innerText()).trim(); if (t && !/Français|English|العربية|Back|Retour|Next Question|Question Suivante|Review|Vérifier|Confirm|Submit|متابعة/i.test(t)) { await b.click(); break; } }\n    await delay(150);\n    if (!(await clickText(page, /Question Suivante|Next Question|السؤال التالي/))) {\n      if (await clickText(page, /Review & Confirm|Vérifier & Confirmer|مراجعة وتأكيد/)) break;\n    }\n    await delay(250);\n  }\n  if (!(await clickText(page, /Save Profile & Start Day|حفظ الملف/))) throw new Error('save profile failed');\n  await page.locator('nav button').first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 });\n  await delay(700);\n}\n\n// ================= T5 — answer incorrectly and recover (NOUR diagnostic) =====\n{\n  const s = await session({ width: 390, height: 844 }, 'T5');\n  try {\n    await s.page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n    await onboard(s.page);\n    await s.page.locator('nav button').nth(3).click(); // NOUR\n    await delay(900);\n    let st = await readState(s.page);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T5-00-nour-diagnostic');\n    // click the first (wrong) diagnostic option button: options are buttons whose text is long Arabic\n    const picked = await s.page.evaluate(() => {\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter((b) => b.getBoundingClientRect().width > 300 && (b.innerText || '').length > 20);\n      if (!btns.length) return null;\n      btns[0].click();\n      return btns[0].innerText.trim().slice(0, 80);\n    });\n    await delay(600);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T5-01-wrong-selected');\n    st = await readState(s.page);\n    const hasFeedback = /Diagnosis|تشخيص|Reasoning|تفكير|Strategy|استراتيجية|Advance to Targeted/i.test(st.body);\n    rec('T5', 'select a diagnostic option', `picked=\"${picked}\" feedback=${hasFeedback}`);\n    // type reasoning then analyze\n    const input = s.page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last();\n    if (await input.count()) { await input.fill('أنا مش متأكدة، يمكن اخترت غلط'); await delay(200); }\n    const analyzed = await clickText(s.page, /Analyze Reasoning|تحليل طريقة تفكيرك/);\n    await delay(700);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T5-02-reasoning-analyzed');\n    st = await readState(s.page);\n    const hasClassification = /Classification|تصنيف|Strategy|استراتيجية/i.test(st.body);\n    const advance = await clickText(s.page, /Advance to Targeted Teaching|الانتقال للشرح/);\n    await delay(800);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T5-03-chalkboard');\n    const st2 = await readState(s.page);\n    const onChalkboard = /Chalkboard|Teaching|الشرح|Board/i.test(st2.body) || st2.body.includes('سبورة');\n    rec('T5', 'analyze reasoning + advance to teaching', `classified=${hasClassification} advanced=${advance}`);\n    results.T5 = {\n      status: picked && hasFeedback && advance ? 'PASS' : 'PARTIAL',\n      evidence: `wrong option selected; feedback shown=${hasFeedback}; reasoning classified=${hasClassification}; advanced to teaching=${Boolean(advance)}; chalkboard visible=${onChalkboard}`,\n      finding: 'Selecting an option immediately reveals per-option diagnostic feedback, then a reasoning text field + \"Analyze Reasoning & Pick Strategy\" step, then an explicit advance to targeted teaching. A wrong answer does not dead-end; the learner gets an explanation and a next step.',\n      body: st.body.slice(0, 800),\n      afterBody: st2.body.slice(0, 500),\n      screenshot: `${outDir}/T5-02-reasoning-analyzed.png`,\n      errors: s.errors,\n    };\n  } catch (e) { results.T5 = { status: 'BLOCKED', error: String(e) }; }\n  await s.context.close();\n}\n\n// ================= T6 — save an item and find it again (LIBRARY) =============\n{\n  const s = await session({ width: 390, height: 844 }, 'T6');\n  try {\n    await s.page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n    await onboard(s.page);\n    await s.page.locator('nav button').nth(2).click(); // LIBRARY\n    await delay(800);\n    // open Units & Lessons so SaveLikeButton renders\n    await clickText(s.page, /Units & Lessons|📑/);\n    await delay(700);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T6-00-library-units');\n    // find a save (bookmark) button by title\n    const savedBy = await s.page.evaluate(() => {\n      const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button'));\n      const save = btns.find((b) => /Save to Collection|حفظ إلى مجموعة|Enregistrer/i.test(b.getAttribute('title') || ''));\n      if (!save) return null;\n      save.click();\n      return save.getAttribute('title');\n    });\n    await delay(600);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T6-01-save-modal');\n    let st = await readState(s.page);\n    const modalOpen = /New collection|nouvelle collection|Personal Note|ملاحظة/i.test(st.body);\n    // create a collection and save\n    const create = await clickText(s.page, /Create new collection|إنشاء مجموعة جديدة/);\n    await delay(300);\n    const nameInput = s.page.locator('input[type=\"text\"]').last();\n    if (await nameInput.count()) { await nameInput.fill('Mes maths'); await delay(150); }\n    const added = await clickText(s.page, /Add|Ajouter|إضافة/);\n    await delay(300);\n    const confirmed = await clickText(s.page, /Save|Enregistrer|حفظ/);\n    await delay(600);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T6-02-after-save');\n    // navigate to collections via menu\n    const menuOpened = await s.page.evaluate(() => {\n      const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => /Menu|القائمة/.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''));\n      if (b) { b.click(); return true; } return false;\n    });\n    await delay(400);\n    const goCollections = await clickText(s.page, /Saved & Collections|المحفوظات والمجموعات/);\n    await delay(700);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T6-03-collections');\n    st = await readState(s.page);\n    const savedVisible = /Mes maths|Mathématiques|Ministry Math/i.test(st.body);\n    rec('T6', 'save lesson to a new collection, reopen from menu', `modal=${modalOpen} create=${create} added=${added} save=${confirmed} collectionsNav=${goCollections} visible=${savedVisible}`);\n    results.T6 = {\n      status: modalOpen && goCollections && savedVisible ? 'PASS' : (modalOpen ? 'PARTIAL' : 'BLOCKED'),\n      evidence: `save modal opened=${modalOpen}; created collection=${Boolean(create)}; added=${added}; saved=${Boolean(confirmed)}; menu->collections=${goCollections}; item visible again=${savedVisible}`,\n      finding: 'The Save-to-Collection flow is reachable from LIBRARY and the saved item is retrievable from the top-menu \"Saved & Collections\" destination, which is not one of the four primary bottom-nav tabs.',\n      body: st.body.slice(0, 800),\n      screenshot: `${outDir}/T6-03-collections.png`,\n      errors: s.errors,\n    };\n  } catch (e) { results.T6 = { status: 'BLOCKED', error: String(e) }; }\n  await s.context.close();\n}\n\n// ================= T7 — empty / error state honesty ==========================\n{\n  const s = await session({ width: 390, height: 844 }, 'T7');\n  try {\n    await s.page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n    await onboard(s.page);\n    // FEED before any mission exists\n    await s.page.locator('nav button').nth(1).click();\n    await delay(700);\n    let st = await readState(s.page);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T7-00-feed-empty');\n    // Collections before saving anything\n    await s.page.evaluate(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => /Menu|القائمة/.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); if (b) b.click(); });\n    await delay(400);\n    await clickText(s.page, /Saved & Collections|المحفوظات والمجموعات/);\n    await delay(700);\n    st = await readState(s.page);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T7-01-collections-empty');\n    const emptyHonest = /no saved|empty|Nothing|Aucun|لا يوجد|ابدأ|Start/i.test(st.body);\n    rec('T7', 'inspect FEED + Collections empty states', `collections empty-state text present=${emptyHonest}`);\n    results.T7 = {\n      status: 'PARTIAL',\n      evidence: `collections empty state text=${emptyHonest}`,\n      finding: 'Empty states are present but were not exercised for network/loading failure, because the app talks to a local server with no API key (health reports hasApiKey:false). A true error-state test needs a reachable provider or a forced failure, which this ticket did not authorize.',\n      body: st.body.slice(0, 700),\n      screenshot: `${outDir}/T7-01-collections-empty.png`,\n      errors: s.errors,\n    };\n  } catch (e) { results.T7 = { status: 'BLOCKED', error: String(e) }; }\n  await s.context.close();\n}\n\n// ================= T8 — phone/desktop + FR/EN/AR-RTL ========================\n{\n  const s = await session({ width: 1365, height: 900 }, 'T8-desktop');\n  try {\n    await s.page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n    await onboard(s.page);\n    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { await s.page.locator('nav button').nth(i).click(); await delay(500); }\n    await s.page.locator('nav button').nth(0).click();\n    await delay(500);\n    const st = await readState(s.page);\n    await shot(s.page, 'T8-home-desktop-1365');\n    results.T8_desktop = { status: st.docW <= st.viewW ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', evidence: `docW=${st.docW} viewW=${st.viewW}`, screenshot: `${outDir}/T8-home-desktop-1365.png`, errors: s.errors };\n  } catch (e) { results.T8_desktop = { status: 'BLOCKED', error: String(e) }; }\n  await s.context.close();\n\n  const a = await session({ width: 390, height: 844 }, 'T8-ar');\n  try {\n    await a.page.goto(baseURL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });\n    await onboard(a.page, { lang: /العربية/, name: 'اختبار' });\n    const st = await readState(a.page);\n    await shot(a.page, 'T8-home-ar-rtl-mobile');\n    await a.page.locator('nav button').nth(1).click(); await delay(600);\n    const stFeed = await readState(a.page);\n    await shot(a.page, 'T8-feed-ar-rtl-mobile');\n    results.T8_ar = {\n      status: st.dir === 'rtl' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL',\n      evidence: `home dir=${st.dir} lang=${st.lang} docW=${st.docW}/${st.viewW}; feed dir=${stFeed.dir} docW=${stFeed.docW}/${stFeed.viewW}`,\n      finding: 'Arabic mode sets document direction to RTL and uses Arabic nav labels; no horizontal overflow measured.',\n      screenshot: `${outDir}/T8-home-ar-rtl-mobile.png`,\n      errors: a.errors,\n    };\n  } catch (e) { results.T8_ar = { status: 'BLOCKED', error: String(e) }; }\n  await a.context.close();\n}\n\nawait writeFile(`${outDir}/trace-part2.json`, JSON.stringify({ trace, results }, null, 2));\nconsole.log('\\n=== PART 2 RESULTS ===');\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));\nawait browser.close();\n",
